# Set79 public DAILY independent reference source

This frozen source has not been executed by its authors. No expected output is
present. Root alone may admit the exact proposed lock and run the two selected
interpreters. This directory is external preparation, not a checkout change.

`PROPOSAL.md` and copied `inputs/contract.md`, `inputs/test-plan.md`,
`inputs/root-selection.json` define scope. `copied-inputs.json` records the exact
qualified public source of every copied input. The old sources/corpora are not
rewritten. All imported executable dependencies are the six new local Python
leaves and Python's standard library; old model files in inputs are documentary
recipes only and are not imported.

The producer consumes original published public key/certificate/funding/proof
examples. It recomposes explicit daily identities and exact selected byte
contracts. It does not generate signatures, new keys, PoW, blocks, financial
history or original-owner capabilities. The unchanged published synthetic backup
mnemonic may occur in its explicitly labeled fixture backup encoding; no user
wallet or secret file is read. The metadata counter, history, receipt-status and
Issue-hold projections are conditional. Concrete source/session/ledger, syncing,
network, signer, unknown writes, crash and joined cleanup tests remain necessary.

Producer leaves:

- `core.py`: canonical framing, domains, scalar/rational predicates.
- `composition.py`: Policy2/Setup2/namespace/guard and credential state bytes.
- `transport.py`: money-bound envelopes, trust and preserved local attachment.
- `payments.py`: exact dated balances, eight-slot pages and frame bounds.
- `outbox.py`: complete daily configuration/namespace and durable Issue hold.
- `generate.py`: exact source/input verification, assembly and one exclusive file.

`recipe.json` fixes literal finite selection, case counts, independent peer frame
cross-checks and bounds. The expected frame numbers originate in the copied
source-only arithmetic note; `payments.py` separately derives each size from its
ordered literal frame. These overestimate possible simultaneously valid money
states. Actual observation validation remains at253402300799999; the frame bound
conservatively permits19 digits. No larger production limit is proposed.

Root invocation, once its separate approved copy has `approved_by:"root"` and
`execution_authorized:true`:

```text
python -B generate.py --inputs /abs/reference/inputs \
  --lock /abs/artifacts/producer-lock.approved.json \
  --out /abs/fresh/reference.json
```

Lock paths resolve relative to this reference source directory, never the
approved lock's artifact directory. The output must be outside this directory
and not exist. Root uses Python3.14 and3.9 separately,120 seconds and1MiB logs per
attempt, and16MiB output, retaining any failure. Require byte-identical output,
all named counts, all source/input hashes unchanged, and all owned processes
joined. Source review and AST parsing are the only author-side checks performed.

Output top-level families are `composition`, `credentials`, `transport`,
`payments`, `outbox`, `raw_cases`, `frame_bounds`, `counts` and source provenance.
Each typed case carries name/valid/scope/value/canonical bytes. Raw cases carry
literal bytes or a bounded explicit padding recipe. Conditional traces carry
events/expected terminal projections/stored modeled bytes. No ID is a capability
and no partial payout page replaces the complete dated ledger balance.

The serialization-only successor preserves the qualified first output and source
under `reference-before-work-wire-order`. The inherited GBT fixture dictionaries
were semantic recipes: maxtime/mintime, witness commitment and transaction hash/txid
ordering differed from the existing transport struct grammar. The locked
`inputs/work-wire-order.json` records that unchanged grammar and copied declarations.
Only cloned object order changes; decoded object equality is mandatory before any
work envelope, stored scan or entry is emitted. Production parsing stays strict.
